name: Radar-TS-TW
title: Radar
blurb: Animated radar display with concentric rings, radial spokes, and a sweeping…
description: WebGL shader rendering rings and spokes radiating from center, with an animated sweep beam. Optional mouse-tracking distortion shifts the center based on pointer position.
use_when: Technical dashboards, sci-fi interfaces, or backgrounds where a sonar/radar aesthetic conveys data or monitoring themes.
avoid_when: WebGL-unsupported devices, or motion-sensitive contexts — continuous rendering and infinite scroll of rings.
a11y: Passive visual background; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
